frozen_problem.gaussians: X1, X2, and T are independent standard real Gaussian variables.
frozen_problem.template: Choose nonzero rational a, set h(z)=a+z, P=W h(Z)+v(Z) T^2, and Q=Z/a, where deg(v)<=2.
frozen_problem.available_identity: For zeta=t h(zeta), E(A(Z) exp(tP)) = A(zeta) * (1-2t v(zeta))^(-1/2) / (1-t h'(zeta)), using the formal square-root branch with constant term 1.
frozen_problem.target: Construct v and zeta so E(P^m)=0 and E(QP^m)=m! for every integer m>=1.
